description: GENERAL ADMISSION, drafted 2026-09-23 as the rule-book route for what `curated-observatory` admits (handover step 8; evidence analysis/stage2_rules_2026-09/REPORT.md). The curated rule's works that no live rule reaches are overwhelmingly works that state the design in the ABSTRACT, not the title — the live claim tiers are title-only — so this rule carries the abstract arms that measured highest-yield per new work, plus two title shapes the title tiers miss. Six arms: (1) the qualifier family (`direct|conceptual|registered|… replication`) anywhere in title+abstract; (2) `our replication(s)`; (3) `replication attempt(s)`; (4) a SUBTITLE replication (`X: a replication …`, `X. Replicating …`) and (5) `replication of the/a(n) …` in the title, both minus the molecular-biology senses (DNA/viral/genome replication, replication fork/origin/stress, replicon, replicase); (6) `we … replicated` or `replication stud(y|ies)` in title+abstract TOGETHER WITH a reference to an original/previous/prior/published study, finding or result in the same text, minus the same biology senses. Arms 1–3 are carried verbatim from `replication-claim-text` (its arms 5, 7 and 6); the prior-study conjunction on arm 6 is what makes `we replicated` affordable — alone it adds 21,919 works. Measured offline over release c048ab6483d3's inputs with `curated-observatory` shadow: recovers 534 of the 1,345 curated works no other rule reaches (508 of the 1,229 the screen proceeded) and adds ~21.6k works beyond today's 9,105-work pile, 647 of them known replications (Observatory or FLoRA DOIs, 29.9/1k). Precedence 735: inside the claim band, below `replication-claim-title-broad` (740) so a title claim keeps its attribution, above `replication-claim-text` (730), whose arms it partly carries. No vocabulary: admission asks for the screen's attention. Admission rules need no `measured` entry.
